# Base64 to image

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/base64-to-image/

Decode a supported image data URL or Base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or WebP into a viewable, downloadable image.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Recover an image from a data URL stored in a development fixture or API response.

## Limits and checks

Only supported raster image formats are accepted. This tool does not execute SVG markup or open embedded links.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
